title: Is this you in this video?
scenario: A friend messages you a link asking, 'is this you in this video??' The message came from their real account, and you weren't expecting it.

answers.A: Click the link since it's from someone you know.
answers.B: Don't click. Message your friend a different way to ask if their account was hacked.
answers.C: Forward it to other friends to warn them, clicking through first to check.

explanation: This is one of the most common hacked-account chains on social media - a compromised friend's account sends the same curiosity-bait link to their whole list.
proTip: A familiar sender doesn't make a surprise link safe - check with them another way first.
